chain.title: The First Alloy
chain.desc: Four andesite ringed around an iron or zinc nugget; every kinetic component in the mod traces back to this one slab.

chain.title: Turning Point
chain.desc: Two andesite alloy stacked in a column yield six shafts, the plain rods that carry rotation from block to block.

chain.title: Teeth That Bite
chain.desc: A shaft surrounded by planks. Cogs mesh side by side, or diagonally onto a large cogwheel to trade speed for reach.

chain.title: The River Pays Rent
chain.desc: A ring of planks around a shaft. Set it in flowing water and it turns forever with no fuel and a generous stress budget.

chain.title: The Engineer's Thumb
chain.desc: A cogwheel, a gold plate and a wooden rod. Rotates placed kinetics, dismantles them intact, and shows block orientation at a glance.

chain.title: Seeing the Stress
chain.desc: Glass, gold plates and string. Worn on the head they overlay stress and speed readouts on every kinetic block you look at.

chain.title: Wrapped in Grey
chain.desc: Right-click any stripped log or stripped wood with andesite alloy; the block takes the casing instantly, no crafting grid needed.

chain.title: Stone That Chews
chain.desc: A cogwheel over stone over andesite casing. The cheapest grinder in the mod, fed by hand or hopper and turned by any rotation at all.

chain.title: The Hammer Falls
chain.desc: Andesite casing, a block of iron and a shaft. It stamps ingots into sheets and compacts whatever sits in a basin below it.

chain.title: Kelp and Motion
chain.desc: Two dried kelp in a column make a belt. Click one shaft, then another in line, and the belt spans between them carrying items and rotation.

chain.title: Boring Through
chain.desc: Andesite alloy, andesite casing and iron. Bolted to a moving contraption it chews the stone ahead of the machine instead of stopping it.

chain.title: The Patient Blade
chain.desc: Iron plates, iron ingots and andesite casing. Upright it cuts logs into planks and strips; laid flat on a contraption it fells whole trees.

chain.title: Wind in a Box
chain.desc: Andesite casing, a propeller and a shaft. Aim it through fire, water, lava or ice and the airflow smelts, washes, smokes or freezes what passes.

chain.title: A Captive Flame
chain.desc: Craft the empty burner from netherrack and iron plates, then trap a blaze inside. It heats basins above it, and blaze cake drives it to superheated.

chain.title: Stirring the Pot
chain.desc: Andesite casing, a whisk and a cogwheel, hung one block above a basin. With heat underneath it runs every mixing recipe in the mod.

chain.title: The Second Metal
chain.desc: Zinc ore hides in shallow stone. Smelt the raw chunks, or crush them in a millstone first to double the yield.

chain.title: Copper Weds Zinc
chain.desc: Mix one copper and one zinc ingot in a heated basin. Nothing in Create's second tier moves without it.

chain.title: Wrapped in Gold
chain.desc: Right-click stripped log or wood with a brass ingot. It is the shell of every smart, filtered, logic-bearing machine the mod ships.

chain.title: Red Glass, Patiently Rubbed
chain.desc: Craft rose quartz from nether quartz and eight redstone, then polish it with sand paper by hand or on a depot under a deployer.

chain.title: Thinking in Redstone
chain.desc: Polished rose quartz set between iron plates. This is the logic part gating deployers, brass tunnels, smart chutes and the mechanical crafter.

chain.title: Automation Crafts Itself
chain.desc: Brass casing, a crafting table and an electron tube. Ring several together, point their arrows into a loop, and they assemble recipes unattended.

chain.title: The Sequenced Heart
chain.desc: A gold sheet on a depot, fed cogwheels, iron sheets and redstone across five deployer passes. The gate item for every advanced machine.

chain.title: Rails Get Serious
chain.desc: Brass casing right-clicked with an obsidian plate. Every station, signal, observer and control panel on the railway is built on this block.

chain.title: All Aboard
chain.desc: Train casing plus a compass. Place it beside laid track, name the stop, and assemble a carriage there to turn a contraption into a scheduled train.

notes: Verified against create-1.20.1-6.0.8.jar. Every chain and collection id is present as assets/create/models/item/<id>.json, except create:encased_fluid_pipe which is lang-only (block.create.encased_fluid_pipe) and is kept under the block-lang rule. Recipe sources read: data/create/recipes/crafting/{materials,kinetics,logistics,appliances}/*, item_application/* for all four casings (andesite/brass/copper/railway casings are right-click applications onto stripped logs or wood, NOT grid recipes), mixing/brass_ingot.json (copper + zinc in a heated basin - this is why blaze_burner and mechanical_mixer sit ahead of brass in the chain), sandpaper_polishing/rose_quartz.json, sequenced_assembly/precision_mechanism.json (gold sheet plus five deployer loops), and sequenced_assembly/track.json. Ponder: assets/create/ponder/ ships only bare .nbt scene layouts with no order index (scene registration lives in code), so no ponder-derived ordering was used; the sole ordering hint in assets is the single chapter texture 'basic_kinetics', which is consistent with shaft/cogwheel/water wheel being the first tier. PACK CONSENSUS vs RECIPES: moddb puts create:copper_diving_helmet at pos 0.092 and create:copper_backtank at pos 0.204 (19 packs each), i.e. the diving set as an early-game reward roughly level with andesite_casing (0.202, 36 packs), even though the backtank costs a full copper block plus andesite alloy and a shaft. Consensus was preferred over the recipe reading: the diving set is NOT pushed to the endgame, it is broken out as its own collection wheel so packs can gate it early. moddb also ranks create:shaft (0.098, 43 packs) and create:andesite_alloy (0.059, 39 packs) as the two most common Create quests overall, matching the chain head exactly. Consensus items left out of the 24-step spine because they are cosmetic or side branches (all verified present in the jar, safe as optional quests): white_table_cloth, red_table_cloth, red_sand_paper, andesite_door, brown_toolbox, item_hatch, white_postbox, builders_tea, crafting_blueprint, purple_seat, scorchia, sail_frame, bound_cardboard_block, cardboard_helmet, cardboard_sword, crushed_raw_iron, crushed_raw_gold. DROPPED: create:deforester - not in this jar (it is a Create: Above and Beyond item); no other candidate failed verification.
